The common thread is that each of those imports pulls in something that is only a type (ClientRow, SortKey, Invoice, ColumnDef, FastifyPluginAsync and so on) with a plain `import { ... }`. With `verbatimModuleSyntax` on, TypeScript no longer drops unused-at-runtime imports for you, so every type must be marked `import type { X }` or inline `import { type X }`. It is mechanical, not a real type bug, and the fix is the same everywhere (the log cuts off partway, so I can only vouch for what is shown).
Action: Run the typecheck on your branch to get the full list, then apply the type-only import fix across it (a bulk fixer like Biome's useImportType can do it) and re-run typecheck to confirm it's clean.

I'll add a job in the worker that loads the org (scoped by orgId), skips if `callback_url` is empty, and POSTs a JSON `invoice.paid` event with a timeout, throwing on non-2xx so the queue retries. I'll keep the URL out of error messages. The enqueue call belongs in the payment-succeeded handler, so I'll point you to that spot rather than guess.
Action: Look at how existing worker jobs are structured and registered, add the invoice-paid delivery job plus tests (success, empty callback_url, non-2xx), and run the worker tests.

I'll add a ServiceMonitor to the worker helm chart targeting the metrics port 9464 and path /metrics. It needs a Service (or pod monitor) exposing that port, and a selector that matches how your Prometheus/Grafana stack discovers monitors, which I don't know yet.
Action: Read the worker chart's templates and values, check whether the worker already has a Service with a named metrics port and what label Prometheus selects on, then add the ServiceMonitor and run helm template to verify it renders.

I'll add msw as a dev dependency in packages/cli with pnpm so the lockfile gets updated too. CI installs with a frozen lockfile, so I'll commit pnpm-lock.yaml together with the package.json change, otherwise the install job fails.
Action: Run `pnpm --filter @acme/cli add -D msw`, confirm the lockfile changed, then set up msw handlers in the invoices tests.
